Lemma
[Smoothness of the Energy Function]

↗ def:riemannian-metric

For a Riemannian manifold, the function \[ E:TM\to \mathbb R,\qquad E(x,v)=\langle v,v\rangle _g, \] is smooth. Consequently $(x,v)\mapsto |v|_g=E(x,v)^{1/2}$ is continuous.
Proof

↗ def:riemannian-metric \sketch Pull $TM$ back along its bundle projection and pair the tautological section with itself using the smooth metric; this is $E$. Compose the nonnegative function $E$ with the continuous square root.

□
